heading: Development planning process

tree.heading: State development plan
tree.text: In accordance with policies established by the Authority, each State member shall submit a development plan for the area of the region represented by the State member.

tree.heading: Content of plan
tree.text: A State development plan submitted under subsection (a) shall reflect the goals, objectives, and priorities identified in the regional development plan developed under section 2009bb–1(d)(2) of this title.

tree.heading: Consultation with interested local parties
tree.text: In carrying out the development planning process (including the selection of programs and projects for assistance), a State may—

children.text: multistate, regional, and local development districts and organizations; and
take into consideration the goals, objectives, priorities, and recommendations of the entities described in paragraph (1).

children.heading: In general
children.text: The Authority and applicable multistate, regional, and local development districts and organizations shall encourage and assist, to the maximum extent practicable, public participation in the development, revision, and implementation of all plans and programs under this subchapter.

children.heading: Regulations
children.text: The Authority shall develop guidelines for providing public participation described in paragraph (1), including public hearings.

notes.heading: Codification
notes.text: Pub. L. 110–234 and Pub. L. 110–246 made identical amendments to this section. The amendments by Pub. L. 110–234 were repealed by section 4(a) of Pub. L. 110–246.

notes.heading: Prior Provisions
notes.text: A prior section 383H of Pub. L. 87–128, title III, was renumbered section 383I and is classified to section 2009bb–7 of this title.

notes.heading: Amendments
notes.text: 2008—Subsec. (c)(1)(A). Pub. L. 110–246, § 6026(h)(1), added subpar. (A) and struck out former subpar. (A) which read as follows: “local development districts; and”. Subsec. (d)(1). Pub. L. 110–246, § 6026(h)(2), substituted “multistate, regional, and local development districts and organizations” for “State and local development districts”.

notes.heading: Effective Date of 2008 Amendment
notes.text: Amendment of this section and repeal of Pub. L. 110–234 by Pub. L. 110–246 effective May 22, 2008, the date of enactment of Pub. L. 110–234, see section 4 of Pub. L. 110–246, set out as an Effective Date note under section 8701 of this title.
